svg.title: seven.wav: the same second of sound, twice
svg.desc: Top: the waveform of a one-second recording of the word seven. Bottom: its spectrogram, time on the horizontal axis and frequency from 0 to 8000 hertz on the vertical axis, darker meaning more energy. The hiss of the s shows as a cloud above 4000 hertz, the two vowels as stacks of dark horizontal bands below 3000 hertz.
